recommendations.increment: Virtual bash/sh and executable script dispatch
recommendations.rationale: Run existing setup/build snippets, file scripts and stdin scripts inside the virtual runtime; preserve args, cwd, env, budgets and cancellation, without native spawning.
Load environment/helper scripts and compose shell snippets with correct caller state and positional restoration; eval must reuse the shell parser, never host JS.

recommendations.increment: Shell fail-fast, discovery and cleanup controls
recommendations.rationale: Common scripts need set -e/-u, command discovery/bypass and cleanup after failure; complete execution semantics before adding more utility names.
Inspect sizes/modes and prepare executable scripts; adapters must expose truthful permission capability and errors, not fake chmod success.
Coding workflows stage files and patches; atomic/exclusive creation, shared mounts and cleanup matter. This name is absent from both inspected default inventories.
Move source/artifact trees through filesystems; defend paths, links and decompression quotas and test real backend effects.
Compare manifests, combine columns and inspect numbered/reversed output without inventing complex awk programs.
Many shell snippets use range generation, scalar expressions and explicit environment inspection; keep locale and overflow behavior explicit.
Timestamp artifacts and bound retry/wait loops using injectable clocks and cancellation rather than uncontrolled host work.
Fetch coding artifacts and call APIs with injected network policy, redirect/size/time limits and no ambient credentials; default-deny, not automatic network access.

priorityBasis: Judgment from missing basic coding workflows and observed feature gaps, NOT measured agent usage or popularity

fullOptions.classification: partial or unverified for both engines; no full native parity audit

documentedCoreOptions.echo: Joined operands; grouped `-n`, `-e`, `-E`; control/octal/hex escapes and `\c` stop.
documentedCoreOptions.printf: Format reuse; `%%`, `%s`, `%b`, `%c`, `%q`, integer/base and common floating formats; numeric width, precision, `-+ #0` flags; binary escape output.
documentedCoreOptions.cat: Ordered files and repeated `-` sharing stdin; raw binary streaming; `-n`, `-b`, `-s`, `-E`, `-T`, `-v`, `-A`, `-e`, `-t`, `-u`.
documentedCoreOptions.pwd: Logical cwd by default/`-L`; filesystem-resolved cwd with `-P`. A shell builtin may take precedence.
documentedCoreOptions.ls: Sorted one-per-line names; `-1`, `-a`, `-A`, `-d`, `-F`, `-p`, `-r`, `-R`, `-L`, `-l`. Long records use numeric metadata and UTC dates.
documentedCoreOptions.mkdir: Multiple directories, recursive parents `-p`, octal mode `-m`, verbose `-v`.
documentedCoreOptions.touch: Create without truncation; `-c`, `-a`, `-m`, reference times `-r`. New files without `-r` retain filesystem-assigned creation timestamps; existing files and reference times require provider timestamp support.
documentedCoreOptions.cp: Multiple sources, `-r`/`-R`, `-n`, `-f`, `-v`, `-P`, `-L`; nested symlink preservation by default; same-file, descendant-copy and cycle checks.
documentedCoreOptions.mv: Virtual rename, multiple sources into directories; `-n`, `-f`, `-v`.
documentedCoreOptions.rm: Files and links; `-r`/`-R`, `-f`, empty directories `-d`, `-v`; root and dot-entry protection.
documentedCoreOptions.ln: Hard and literal symbolic links, `-s`, `-f`, `-n`, `-T`; multiple sources into target directories.
documentedCoreOptions.readlink: Literal link targets; canonical `-f`, existing-only `-e`, no newline `-n`, NUL `-z`.
documentedCoreOptions.dirname: Multiple path operands, trailing slashes and roots, `-z`.
documentedCoreOptions.realpath: Existing paths and missing final component; `-e`, `-m`, `-z`.
documentedCoreOptions.head: Default ten lines, `-n`, `-c`, legacy leading `-NUMBER`, negative omit-last counts, `-q`, `-v`; early input termination.
documentedCoreOptions.tail: Default last ten lines, `-n`, `-c`, legacy leading `-NUMBER`, `+N` origins, `-q`, `-v`; bounded suffix buffering.
documentedCoreOptions.wc: `-l`, `-w`, `-c`, `-m`; multiple files and totals; byte counting and UTF-8 decoding across chunk boundaries.
documentedCoreOptions.sort: Byte ordering, exact decimal numeric comparison `-n`, `-r`, `-f`, `-b`, `-s`, `-u`, `-t`, repeated `-k` with field/character ranges and `bfnr` modifiers, `-o`, `-c`, `-z`.
documentedCoreOptions.uniq: Adjacent groups, `-c`, `-d`, `-u`, `-i`, field/byte skips `-f`/`-s`, comparison width `-w`, `-z`, optional input/output paths.
documentedCoreOptions.cut: Byte `-b`, UTF-8 codepoint `-c`, field `-f` ranges including open/overlapping ranges; `-d`, `-s`, `-z`, `--complement`, `--output-delimiter`.
documentedCoreOptions.tr: Byte ranges/classes/escapes, translation, `-d`, `-s`, `-c`/`-C`; squeeze state persists across chunks.
documentedCoreOptions.tee: Incremental stdout and multiple file writes; append `-a`; continues remaining outputs after a file error.
documentedCoreOptions.find: Sorted traversal, `-P`/`-L`, depth bounds and `-depth`, name/path patterns, file/directory/link types, `-size`, `-empty`, boolean expressions, `-prune`, `-print`/`-print0`, literal `-exec ... ;` and batched `-exec ... {} +`.
documentedCoreOptions.xargs: Incremental quoted/escaped word parsing; `-0`, `-d`, `-n`, `-s`, `-I`, `-r`, `-t`, `-E`, `-x`, sequential `-P 1`; child failure status mapping.
documentedCoreOptions.env: Listing, clearing `-i`/`-`, unsetting `-u`, assignments, NUL listing `-0`, virtual directory override `-C`, direct command execution.
